computation_or_rationale: Expenses are always decreases in NA without donor restrictions; spending 30,000 for the restricted purpose releases 30,000 (reclassification) and the expense is reported without restrictions (ASC 958-205-45-9/45-11; 958-225-45-7).
Analysis of expenses by function and nature is required of all NFPs (ASU 2016-14, ASC 958-205-45-6) and has no business counterpart; SCF exists for businesses; (c)/(d) are business statements.
Board designations are internal and reversible; net assets remain without donor restrictions (ASC 958-210-45-? / 958-205 glossary).
Donor stipulation that gift be used next year = time restriction -> with donor restrictions. Salaries are expenses (without), board designation is without, unrestricted dues are without.
Post ASU 2016-14, absent explicit donor stipulation, restriction on long-lived asset gift released when asset placed in service (ASC 958-205-45-12).
700,000 + 150,000 releases - 820,000 expenses = 30,000 increase. Restricted 200,000 goes to with-donor-restrictions class.
Controller salary = management and general (supporting). Meals, scholarships, vaccines are program services.
ASU 2016-14: investment return presented net of external and direct internal investment expenses (ASC 958-225-45-14).

Cash 300,000 + receivables due in 6 months 120,000 + investments (900,000 - 600,000 perpetual corpus) 300,000 = 720,000. Pledge restricted to next year's program excluded (donor-restricted; stem says ignore expected releases).
ASU 2016-14 removed the requirement to present the indirect reconciliation when the direct method is used.
Corpus to be held in perpetuity = with donor restrictions (perpetual in nature); income use is separate question.

ASC 958-205-45-11: when both restricted and unrestricted resources are available for the purpose, the restriction is fulfilled to the extent of the expense -> full 25,000 released (lesser of expense 40,000 and restricted 25,000).
Fund-balance-by-fund statement is not required for private NFPs (governmental concept). Required: position, activities, cash flows (+ expense analysis).
Contributions restricted for long-term purposes (endowment) are financing inflows (ASC 230-10-45-14(c)).
300,000 - 40,000 unrealized gain - 100,000 long-term restricted gift (financing) = 160,000.
ASU 2016-14 requires all NFPs to present expense analysis by function and nature (ASC 958-720-45-15).
Qualitative + quantitative information about availability of financial assets to meet general expenditures within one year of the balance sheet date (ASC 958-210-50-1A).
ASC 958-720-45-29: joint costs allocated only if purpose, audience and content criteria all met; otherwise all fundraising.
Release = reclassification (NA with -> NA without), shown as net assets released from restrictions.
Board quasi-endowment = without donor restrictions (board designation).
Expenses reported as decreases in NA without donor restrictions (ASC 958-225-45-7). Note choice wording uses outdated 'unrestricted'.
ASC 958-205-45-? (UPMIFA): earnings on donor-restricted endowment classified as with donor restrictions until appropriated for expenditure.
Position, activities, cash flows, and analysis of expenses by function and nature. (a) wording is vague.
Two classes post ASU 2016-14.
Board designation -> without donor restrictions.
Purpose-restricted income -> with donor restrictions until spent for scholarships.
Fundraising is a supporting activity.
Availability of financial assets within one year (958-210-50-1A).
Net of external and direct internal investment expenses (958-225-45-14).
Release from restriction reported as reclassification (NA with -> without) and expense in without class.
